transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I keep losing interest in the projects and activities I usually care about, even when everything in my life is going fine. Lately, I just can't seem to stay engaged with my landscaping work or the art projects that normally excite me.
How long have you been feeling this loss of interest and low engagement—has it been most days for at least two years, or is it a more recent change?

It hasn't been two years, but this low spell of losing interest has been hanging around for most of the past year. Looking back, I've noticed these cycles of getting really revved up and then sinking into these low stretches have been happening off and on for about a year now.
During the times when you feel "revved up," do you also have a lot more energy or need much less sleep, or are those periods just brief improvements in mood and interest?

Yes, it’s definitely a massive surge of energy that goes way beyond just a normal good mood. I'll wake up before my alarm buzzing with energy, clean the whole apartment, and work on art projects without feeling tired at all. At night, my mind races so fast with different ideas that I just can't slow it down to fall asleep.
During those high-energy periods, do you also become more impulsive or risky than usual, such as spending a lot, talking much more than normal, or doing things others say are out of character?

Yes, I definitely get pretty impulsive, especially with my spending when I'm wired. I've put expensive camping gear and art supplies on my credit card, and even put down a deposit on a last-minute trip without checking my budget. Later on, I end up really stressing about how I'm actually going to pay it all off.
Have these high-energy periods ever lasted at least 4 days in a row, or have they ever lasted a week or more and caused major problems at work, at home, or led to hospitalization?

Yes, those high-energy stretches usually last for a few days, right around four days at a time. They definitely cause some issues—like missed deadlines at work and arguments with my girlfriend over my inconsistency—but they've never been severe enough to cause a total collapse or lead to hospitalization.
Have you ever had a period of at least 7 days where your mood was unusually elevated or irritable and your energy was much higher than normal, even if it did not lead to hospitalization?

I definitely get those periods of feeling unusually amped up, upbeat, or irritable with a ton of energy, but they never last a full seven days. Usually, those high stretches only last for a few days at a time. These cycles have been happening off and on for about a year now.

final_diagnosis.reason: The interview is most consistent with bipolar disorder spectrum illness: recurrent episodes of elevated/irritable mood with increased energy, decreased need for sleep, racing thoughts, increased goal-directed activity, and impulsive spending, lasting about 4 days and causing functional problems. However, the episodes do not meet full duration for hypomania/mania as described, and the overall pattern over about a year suggests a bipolar disorder diagnosis rather than a unipolar depressive disorder.
